Definition: Measures the success rate of establishing a Downlink TBF for packet data transfer
Effect: Low rate indicates poor radio environment or insufficient resources

Definition: Probability of failure to access SDCCH during call setup
Effect: High congestion prevents call setup, SMS delivery, and location updates

Definition: Probability of failure to access TCH during call setup
Effect: High congestion means no voice channels available, users hear busy tones

Definition: Percentage of calls prematurely terminated before normal release on Traffic Channels
Effect: High drop rate indicates poor coverage, interference, or equipment issues

Definition: Percentage of signaling connections dropped on SDCCH before call setup completes
Effect: High rate means signaling failures during call initiation

Definition: Ratio of successful call establishments to total call attempts
Effect: Low rate means high call setup failures, users cannot connect calls

Definition: Measures ability to successfully transfer an ongoing call from one cell to another
Effect: Low rate causes dropped calls during mobility

Definition: Ratio of successful RRC connection establishments to attempts
Effect: Low rate means UEs cannot establish radio connection, users cannot access any service

Definition: Ratio of successful AMR (voice) RAB establishments to attempts
Effect: Low rate means voice service accessibility is degraded

Definition: Ratio of successful PS (data) RAB establishments to attempts
Effect: Low rate means data service accessibility is degraded

Definition: Combines RRC and RAB success to measure overall call establishment performance
Effect: Low rate reflects poor network accessibility

Definition: Ratio of abnormal AMR RAB releases to successful RAB establishments
Effect: High drop rate means voice calls are frequently dropped, user dissatisfaction

Definition: Ratio of abnormal PS RAB releases to successful PS RAB establishments
Effect: High drop rate means data sessions are frequently interrupted

Definition: Success rate of handover from UMTS to GSM for voice calls
Effect: Low rate causes voice calls to drop when users move out of UMTS coverage

Definition: Success rate of handover from UMTS to GSM for data sessions
Effect: Low rate causes data session drops during inter-RAT mobility

Definition: Success rate of make-before-break handover where UE maintains multiple simultaneous links
Effect: Low rate increases call drop risk during mobility

Definition: Success rate of handover between different UMTS frequencies
Effect: Low rate means poor mobility between frequency layers

Definition: Percentage of successful RRC connection establishments between UE and network
Effect: Low rate means UEs cannot establish radio connection, users cannot access LTE service

Definition: Percentage of successful Evolved Radio Access Bearer setups for data transmission
Effect: Low rate means UEs cannot establish radio bearer, users cannot transmit/receive data

Definition: Percentage of services (voice/data) dropped after successful establishment
Effect: High drop rate means poor service retainability, users experience frequent interruptions

Definition: Success rate of handover between cells on the same frequency
Effect: Low rate causes service drops during mobility within same frequency layer

Definition: Success rate of handover between cells on different frequencies
Effect: Low rate causes service disruptions when moving between frequency layers, essential for spectrum efficiency

Definition: Percentage of data packets lost in the uplink direction
Effect: High rate means poor uplink quality, users experience slow uploads and poor voice/video call quality

Definition: Percentage of data packets lost in the downlink direction
Effect: High rate means poor downlink quality, users experience buffering, slow browsing, and poor streaming

Definition: Percentage of successful S1 setup procedures between eNodeB and EPC
Effect: Low rate means UEs cannot establish connection to core network, users cannot access network services

Definition: Success rate of preparing Circuit Switched Fallback from LTE to 2G/3G for voice calls
Effect: Low rate means voice calls (CSFB) fail to establish, users on LTE cannot make or receive voice calls

Definition: Percentage of DL Physical Resource Blocks used during busy hour
Effect: High PRB utilization indicates cell congestion, needs expansion or optimization

Definition: Percentage of UL Physical Resource Blocks used during busy hour
Effect: High PRB utilization indicates cell congestion, needs expansion or optimization

Definition: Percentage of configured TCHs available for service
Effect: Fewer channels available for users, impacts capacity and accessibility

Definition: Percentage of time the UMTS radio network (RNC/cells) is available for service
Effect: Availability loss impacts coverage and all services in the affected area

Definition: Percentage of time radio network is available for service
Effect: Low availability impacts coverage, users lose service in affected areas

Definition: Ratio of successful radio channel assignment procedures (SDCCH/TCH assignment after channel request) to total assignment attempts
Effect: Low rate means UEs fail to get a channel assigned even after signaling access succeeds, blocking call/SMS/location update completion

Definition: Ratio of successful immediate assignment (initial channel allocation responding to a channel request) to total immediate assignment attempts
Effect: Low rate means UEs cannot get an initial channel allocated, blocking the very first step of call/SMS/location update attempts

Definition: Percentage of configured TRXs (transceivers) actually available for service
Effect: Low availability reduces usable radio resources, increasing congestion and blocking risk

Definition: Combined SDCCH+TCH radio resource utilization relative to configured capacity
Effect: High utilization signals capacity exhaustion risk, an early warning sign before congestion appears

Definition: Percentage of interference-band measurement samples falling in the two worst interference bands (4-5 on a 0-5 scale)
Effect: High proportion indicates significant uplink interference degrading call quality and drop rate; threshold/scale to be confirmed by RF team

Definition: Percentage of downlink quality-index (HQI) samples within the acceptable 0-5 band
Effect: Low proportion indicates poor downlink voice/signal quality experienced by users; scale/direction assumption to be confirmed by RF team

Definition: Percentage of uplink quality-index (HQI) samples within the acceptable 0-5 band
Effect: Low proportion indicates poor uplink voice/signal quality experienced by users; scale/direction assumption to be confirmed by RF team

Definition: Success rate of hard handovers between cells on the same UMTS frequency
Effect: Low rate causes call drops when a hard handover is required within the same frequency layer

Definition: Mean Received Total Wideband Power measured at the NodeB uplink receiver
Effect: Elevated RTWP indicates uplink interference or a hardware/PIM issue, reducing uplink coverage and capacity; baseline depends on hardware/band, to be calibrated by RF team

Definition: Success rate of VoLTE (Voice over LTE) call/bearer setup
Effect: Low rate means VoLTE calls fail to establish, users on LTE experience voice call setup failures

Definition: Average uplink interference (noise) power measured at the eNodeB receiver
Effect: High interference degrades uplink SINR, reducing uplink throughput/coverage and increasing drop/retransmission rates; baseline depends on band/antenna config, to be calibrated by RF team
